verdict.rationale: Pipecat's production telephony docs say inbound calls come from your own carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) hitting your webhook. The site advertises SIP and PSTN transports, and the runner supports a Twilio transport flag, so you bring your own carrier rather than using bundled telephony. missing for 10: explicit PBX/SIP-trunk configuration documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SIP connectivity.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) is calling your webhook to tell you there's an inbound call
